bio.es: Mckenna Grace (Grapevine, Texas, Estados Unidos; 25 de junio de 2006) es una actriz y cantante estadounidense. Comenzó su carrera interpretativa a los seis años, participando en series de televisión como Crash & Bernstein (2012–2014) y The Young and the Restless (2013–2015), antes de darse a conocer internacionalmente en el cine al protagonizar el drama Un don excepcional (2017) junto a Chris Evans.

bio.en: Steven Vincent Buscemi (born December 13, 1957) is an American actor. His early credits consist of significant roles in independent film productions such as Parting Glances (1986), Mystery Train (1989), In the Soup (1992), and his breakout role as Mr. Pink in Quentin Tarantino's Reservoir Dogs (1992). Buscemi has appeared in both independent and mainstream films, including Living in Oblivion (1995), Desperado (1995), Con Air (1997), Armageddon (1998), Ghost World (2001), Big Fish (2003), and The Death of Stalin (2017). Buscemi has often collaborated with the Coen brothers, appearing in Miller's Crossing (1990), Fargo (1996), and The Big Lebowski (1998).

bio.en: Charles John Huffam Dickens (7 February 1812 – 9 June 1870) was an English writer and social critic. He created some of the world's best-known fictional characters and is regarded as the greatest novelist of the Victorian era. His works enjoyed unprecedented popularity during his lifetime, and by the twentieth-century critics and scholars had recognised him as a literary genius. His novels and short stories enjoy lasting popularity. Description above from the Wikipedia Charles Dickens licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

Travis Andrew Knight (born September 13, 1973) is an American animator, producer, director, actor, and former rapper. The son of Nike co-founder Phil Knight has worked as the lead animator and current CEO for the stop-motion animation studio Laika, including directing the company's films Kubo and the Two Strings (2016) and Wildwood (2026). He also directed the live-action films Bumblebee (2018) and Masters of the Universe (2026). Knight received three nominations for the Academy Awards. bio.en: Erica Rivinoja (born December 19, 1984) is an American film and television writer, producer and director. She was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay for co-writing Borat Subsequent Moviefilm. Her other film screenplays include Extreme Movie (2008) and Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2 (2013), and story credits on Trolls (2016), Girls Trip (2017), and The Addams Family (2019). She is set to make her directorial debut with an animated adaptation of The Cat in the Hat. From 2001 to 2012, Rivinoja was a writer and consultant on the animated comedy series South Park, which earned her two Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Animated Program from four nominations.

bio.es: Jonathan Kimble Simmons (9 de enero de 1955), más conocido como J. K. Simmons, es un actor estadounidense ganador del Óscar, Globo de Oro, BAFTA, Premio del Sindicato de Actores, entre otros premios. Es conocido por su papel del neonazi Vernon Schillinger en la serie Oz, de HBO, por su papel como J, Jonah Jameson en las películas de Spider-Man, como también sus papeles en dos películas de los hermanos Coen, The Ladykillers y Burn After Reading. Ganó el Óscar a Mejor actor de Reparto por su participación como Terence Fletcher en la película Whiplash, de 2014.

bio.en: Nabhaan Rizwan is a British actor known for his work in film and television. He gained prominence for his role as Raza Shar in the British drama series "Informer" (2018). Rizwan's compelling performance in the series garnered attention and critical acclaim. Additionally, he has appeared in various other projects, including "Station Eleven," showcasing his talent and versatility as an actor. Rizwan continues to make strides in the entertainment industry, establishing himself as a promising talent to watch.

Billy Evans is an American businessman who founded and runs Haemanthus, a diagnostics start-up based in Austin, Texas. He is also the partner of Elizabeth Holmes. Elizabeth was the founder of health company Theranos and is currently serving 11.25 years in prison for fraud. Holmes and Evans share two children. Billy is featured on A24's 2026 documentary You Can See Everything, directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim.

bio.en: Emily Piggford is a Canadian actress known for her diverse roles in television, film, and theater. She gained significant recognition for her starring role in the web series That's My DJ, for which she received a Canadian Screen Award nomination for Best Performance by an Actress.

bio.es: Yasujirō Ozu fue un director de cine y guionista japonés que inició su carrera en la era del cine mudo. Empezó realizando comedias cortas, pasándose en la década de los años 30 a temáticas más serias. El matrimonio y la familia, especialmente las relaciones entre generaciones, son temas destacados en la obra de Ozu. Entre sus películas más elogiadas se encuentran «Primavera tardía» (1949), «Cuentos de Tokio» (1953), «La hierba errante» (1959) y «El sabor del sake» (1962). Su reputación no ha parado de crecer desde su muerte, y es ampliamente considerado como uno de los directores más influyentes del mundo.

bio.en: Tsai Ming-liang (Chinese: 蔡 明亮, Pinyin: Cài Míngliàng; born October 27, 1957) is a Malaysian-Taiwanese filmmaker. He has written and directed 11 feature films and has also directed many short films, television films, documentaries and art installations. Tsai is one of the most celebrated "Second New Wave" film directors of Taiwanese cinema. His films have been acclaimed worldwide and have won numerous film festival awards.

bio.es: Matthew Paige Damon (Cambridge, Massachusetts; 8 de octubre de 1970) es un actor, guionista y filántropo estadounidense. Su carrera se inició a raíz del éxito de la película Good Will Hunting (1997), a partir de un guion escrito con su amigo Ben Affleck. Fue ganador del premio Óscar al mejor guion original por Good Will Hunting y nominado a mejor actor por el mismo trabajo. Damon desde entonces ha participado en películas de éxito comercial como Saving Private Ryan (1998) o dando vida a Jason Bourne.

Robert Douglas Thomas Pattinson (Barnes, Londres, Inglaterra; 13 de mayo de 1986) es un actor y músico británico. Comenzó su carrera interpretativa en producciones teatrales en Londres antes de dar el salto al cine interpretando a Cedric Diggory en Harry Potter y el cáliz de fuego (2005). Alcanzó reconocimiento mundial gracias a su papel de Edward Cullen en la saga cinematográfica Crepúsculo (2008-2012).

bio.es: Corey Antonio Hawkins (Washington D. C., Estados Unidos; 22 de octubre de 1988) es un actor estadounidense. Graduado de la Escuela Juilliard, comenzó su carrera en el teatro neoyorquino antes de obtener reconocimiento internacional en el cine al interpretar al rapero Dr. Dre en el drama biográfico Straight Outta Compton (2015).

bio.en: Ranbir Raj Kapoor (born 28 September 1982) is an Indian actor who works in Hindi-language films. He is one of the most prominent male actors working today in Bollywood. The son of actors Rishi Kapoor and Neetu Singh, and the grandson of actor-director Raj Kapoor, Kapoor pursued filmmaking and method acting at the School of Visual Arts and the Lee Strasberg Theatre and Film Institute, respectively. Over the years, Kapoor has built a reputation for choosing diverse roles. He has played everything from a troubled musician in “Rockstar” (2011) to a historical figure in “Besharam” (2013) and a gangster in “Barfi!” (2012), earning praise for his emotional depth and naturalistic style.

Rakul Preet Singh (born 10 October 1991) is an Indian actress who works predominantly in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, and Kannada cinema. She made her acting debut in the Kannada film *Gilli* (2009), followed by her Telugu debut in *Keratam* (2011) and Tamil debut in *Thadaiyara Thaakka* (2012). Her breakthrough in Telugu cinema came with Merlapaka Gandhi's *Venkatadri Express* (2013), for which she received a Filmfare Award for Best Actress – Telugu nomination. She made her Hindi starring debut in Divya Khosla Kumar's *Yaariyan* (2014).

Emmanuel Jacomy is a French voice actor who specializes in dubbing. He is the official dubbing voice of Pierce Brosnan as of 1995 but also is the dubbing voice of Denzel Washington, Forest Whitaker and many others.
David Bickerstaff is an Australian artist and a filmmaker based in London.

bio.es: Eva Marie Saint (nacida el 4 de julio de 1924) es una actriz estadounidense que ha protagonizado películas, Broadway y televisión en una carrera que abarca siete décadas. Es conocida por aportar profundidad emocional y complejidad a sus papeles, en los que generalmente interpretaba Mujeres que parecen frágiles pero tienen una gran fuerza interior. Ganó un Premio de la Academia a la Mejor Actriz de Reparto por su actuación en la película dramática "On the Waterfront" (1954), y luego protagonizó la película de suspenso "North by Northwest" (1959), dirigida por Alfred Hitchcock.

bio.en: Devid Striesow (born October 1, 1973 in Bergen auf Rügen) is a German actor. He starred as "Sturmbannführer Herzog" (Bernhard Krüger) in Stefan Ruzowitzky's 2007 film The Counterfeiters, which was awarded the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film for that year. 2022 Devid got his biggest role so far which is General Friedrichs in «All Quiet On The Western Front» Description above from the Wikipedia article Devid Striesow, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

André Léon Marie Nicolas Rieu (born 1 October 1949) is a Dutch violinist and conductor best known for creating the waltz-playing Johann Strauss Orchestra. Rieu and his orchestra have turned classical and waltz music into a worldwide concert touring act. He resides in his native Maastricht. The name Rieu is of French Huguenot origin, though both of Rieu's parents were Roman Catholic. André was born to Andries Antonie Rieu and is the third of six children. Rieu's father was conductor of the Maastricht Symphony Orchestra. Showing early promise, André began studying violin at the age of five. From a very early age, he developed a fascination with orchestra.

bio.es: Sir Patrick Stewart es un actor británico de cine y televisión, conocido principalmente por sus papeles en obras de teatro de William Shakespeare y, especialmente, por ser el Capitán Jean-Luc Picard de la serie La Nueva Generación de la saga de Star Trek (Viaje a las Estrellas) y el Profesor Xavier en las películas de X-Men. Stewart ha sido nombrado oficial de la Orden del Imperio Británico en la lista honorífica de año nuevo de 2001.

Hugh Anthony Quarshie (born 22 December 1954) is a Ghanaian-born British actor of stage, television, and film. bio.en: Jack Creley was an American-born Canadian actor with a career spanning theatre, film, and television, Creley's talent shone brightly on stages and screens alike. He graced prestigious theatre companies, including the renowned Stratford Festival, showcasing his skill in both classic and contemporary plays. In film, he left an indelible mark with roles in movies such as Videodrome (1983), Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb (1964) and Police Academy 4: Citizens on Patrol (1987).

bio.es: Alberto Romero Tomás (17 de noviembre de 1974)​ más conocido como Berto Romero, es un humorista, guionista y actor español. Participó en los programas de humor Buenafuente (La Sexta), Buenas noches y Buenafuente (Antena 3) y En el aire (La Sexta) y fue columnista del diario Público. Actualmente presenta junto a Andreu Buenafuente el programa de radio de la Cadena SER Nadie sabe nada, donde improvisan temas propuestos por los radio oyentes, y también participa como colaborador en el programa Late motiv presentado por Andreu Buenafuente en #0 de Movistar+. En el ámbito de la ficción, protagoniza la serie Mira lo que has hecho.

bio.es: María Dolores González Flores es su nombre completo. Miembro de una saga artística, es la mayor de los tres hijos de Lola Flores "La Faraona" y Antonio González "El Pescaílla", y hermana de Antonio y Rosario Flores. Tiene dos hermanos por parte de padre: Antonia "La pescaílla" y Juan Santos. Famosa desde su nacimiento, desde niña participaba en las fiestas familiares, pero no debutó como cantante hasta los 17 años, triunfando en 1975 con "Amor, amor", a la que seguieron "Qué será de mí", "No renunciaré", "Sí pero no" o "Lo voy a dividir".

Lluís Homar Toboso (Barcelona, 20 de abril de 1957) es un actor y director teatral español. En marzo de 2019 es nombrado director de la Compañía Nacional de Teatro Clásico, incorporándose al cargo el 1 de septiembre de 2019. Nació el 20 de abril de 1957 en la ciudad de Barcelona. Estudió la educación primaria en la escuela de su familia "Escuelas Homar" del barrio barcelonés de Horta. Fue monaguillo de la parroquia de Sant Joan de Horta. Estudió sin concluirla la carrera de Derecho en la Universidad Autónoma de Barcelona y acudió al Instituto del Teatro barcelonés. En la actualidad reside en Canet de Mar.

bio.en: Pere Arquillué i Cortadella (Terrassa, Vallès Occidental, 17 March 1967) is a Catalan actor of theatre, cinema, television and dubbing. He lives in Matadepera and is the father of actress Emma Arquillué. He made his professional debut in theatre with the play Tàlem, by Sergi Belbel. He has participated in television series such as Secrets de família, Estació d'enlaç or Jet lag. He has also shot a few films and TV films.
